pred_ddx.label: CNS relapse of acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL)

Graft-versus-host disease (GVHD): The patient's symptoms, laboratory findings, and history of BMT are consistent with GVHD, and the presence of mature T-cells of donor origin in the CSF suggests a donor-derived immune response against the host CNS.
CNS relapse of acute lymphoblastic leuke: Although the patient has a history of ALL, the presence of mature T-cells of donor origin in the CSF and the lack of clonality in the host cells make CNS relapse of ALL less likely.
